item.title: Quote of the day by pioneer of cybernetics Norbert Wiener: 'The automated machine is the economic equivalent of slave labour' — foreshadowing the displacement of human labor in the years to come
item.description: Before the term AI was even coined, scientists were warning about the potential for intelligent machines to replace humans

item.title: I defected to the PS5 after 30 years of PC gaming — here's why I have no regrets about swapping the RAM crisis for the disc crisis
item.description: Disc-less Elysium: I'm a veteran PC gamer who vowed not to buy a PS5 — but I changed my mind, and I don't regret switching to Sony's console for a second.

item.title: Rachika Nayar’s Heaven Come Crashing is an instrumental epic of desperate longing
item.description: Two minutes and thirty seconds into the title track of Rachika Nayar's Heaven Come Crashing, an absolutely massive drum and bass beat drops. As a fan of Nayar's debut record Our Hands Against The Dusk, it caught me off guard. That album has no percussion on it at all. Heaven Comes Crashing is almost entirely […]

item.title: The global memory shortage hits the MacBook Air
item.description: The global memory chip shortage appears to be affecting the availability of Apple’s most popular Mac.

item.title: Russia is planning a tethered mother drone carrying up to six wired mini spy UAVs
item.description: Russia patented a tethered carrier drone capable of launching six reconnaissance copters while supplying continuous power, communications, and automated recovery.

item.title: I finally got Flight Simulator 2024 off the runway — and it’s far more gorgeous and far more grueling than I ever imagined
item.description: I’ve been trying my flying skills out on the gorgeous Flight Simulator 2024 at last. Brace yourself — it’s been a very rough journey.

item.title: Sam Altman and AI’s decel debate
item.description: On the latest episode of Equity, we discuss why Sam Altman has calling on the industry to "pace the rate of AI development."

item.title: Un mini PC capable de faire tourner de l’IA en local en promotion, c’est possible
item.description: Le GMKtec EVO-X2 AI est l'un des mini PC les plus puissants du marché, armé d'un AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 et de 64 Go de mémoire unifiée. Il est actuellement proposé à 2 079 euros au lieu de 2 365,46 euros sur Amazon.

item.title: US confirms it will leverage Ukraine's expertise in military drones before competing to 'be the world champions'
item.description: The Pentagon is adopting Ukrainian drone expertise while expanding domestic manufacturing to reduce America's significant production gap and strengthen capabilities.
